scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official 23 October 2026 BFCM conversion-ramp guidance, Creator workflow guidance, current monthly creator trends, the 2026 Palette and relevant public Pinterest inspiration were checked on 24 October 2026. The newest item reinforces phased creative: inspiration and saves early, clearer product/value/action as intent rises, and price, availability and purchase-path visibility through the peak period. Current aesthetic signals remain seasonal executions rather than durable command gaps.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.26.0 with 721 commands was read before evaluation. /intent-to-action already maps discovery, confidence, decision and action; /performance-creative-mix assigns distinct asset roles and tests; /catalog-creative-system protects product, price, availability and destination parity; /content-lifecycle-system covers planning, cadence, reuse and analytics-led refresh. No materially new, non-duplicate command was warranted. The userscript and metadata remained byte-identical, and all 22 regression checks passed.
trends: BFCM creative should begin before the promotion window while shoppers are saving, comparing and building shortlists
Asset roles should evolve as intent sharpens: inspiration and curation first, then product, value, availability and low-friction action
Campaign visibility should continue through Cyber Monday and early December while shoppers are still comparing
Creator-workflow guidance continues to favour research, board-based planning, platform-aware reuse and analytics-led refresh
Current creator aesthetics include Copper Hair, Suede Styling, Vamp Romantic and Glamoratti
The 2026 Palette continues to favour monochrome statements, seasonal colour roles and colour-led discovery
skipped: No BFCM conversion-ramp command because /intent-to-action, /performance-creative-mix, /catalog-creative-system and /content-lifecycle-system already cover phased asset jobs, product truth, cadence and conversion paths
No urgency or holiday-countdown command because timing and offer mechanics belong in the campaign brief, while manufactured urgency would reduce trust
No Copper Hair, Suede Styling, Vamp Romantic or Glamoratti aliases because existing beauty, material, palette, theatrical and trend-to-brand commands translate them safely
No individual 2026 Palette colour commands because /emotional-palette and /taste-discovery-system already support exact colour roles and brand adaptation

No retro-futurism, chaos-packaging, neo-minimalism or saturation-revival aliases because public Pinterest inspiration repeated capabilities already covered by visual-style, packaging and trend-translation commands
